title: hidane official emulator difference database
description: docs/parity-exceptions.json: every place where the official Cloud Firestore emulator, production Firestore and hidane do not all behave the same. Edited by hand and checked by tools/parity/differences.py, which writes the tables of docs/parity-exceptions.md from it. docs/parity-exceptions.md explains each field.

schema_version.description: The version of this format; it changes when a field is removed or changes meaning.

retired.description: The entries hidane no longer departs on, by ID (an ID is never reused), with why each went.

reason.description: Why the entry went, and since when.

text.description: Markdown, as it appears in a table cell of docs/parity-exceptions.md.

id.description: A stable ID: D001, D002, … in the order entries were added; a new entry takes the next one, and an ID is never reused (a retired entry's ID stays in `retired`).

table.description: The table of docs/parity-exceptions.md it is in: hidane departing from the official emulator on purpose, or the official emulator departing from production with the parity target decided.

area.description: Its area in the parity table (tools/parity/table.py, AREAS).

topic.description: The production table's Area column; null in the other table.

firestore.description: What production Firestore does, where the entry knows it; null where nothing recorded says (production is not observed yet: #82).

reason.description: Why: the intentional table's Why column, or the production table's Decision column.

references.description: Issues (`hidane-dev/hidane#86`, `firebase/firebase-tools#11241`), web pages, and files or pages of the repository (globs allowed). Every one the entry's text mentions must be here; more may be added, such as the fixture or test that pins hidane's side.

pinned_by.description: The tests that fail if hidane stops doing what `hidane` says, each `<file>::<test function>`; empty when none does, and then `unpinned` says why.

unpinned.description: Why no test pins hidane's side; only where `pinned_by` is empty.
